collection.credit:
* V10 reputation, appointment, school and rivalry events: event prose
  and detailed branching by ChatGPT. Requested social outcomes and
  leadership roles, including ostracism, laughingstock, village idiot,
  mad scientist, trusted advisor, teacher and heads of professions:
  Lorsieab2. VV3–VV5-only Magic/Nature faction rule: Lorsieab2.

ledger.why: the advisor reputation is story only (rule 7); the VV3 Chief is never replaced or targeted

items.text: how to divide a scarce harvest fairly
whether to rebuild a damaged workshop or a damaged path first
how to settle a long-running rivalry between artisans
whether to fund an ambitious but poorly tested invention
how to allocate teaching time between beginners and experts
how to preserve an elder's old records without changing them
(Subject) offers a simple, effective compromise.
(Subject) freezes under attention. A friend helps (subject.him/her) explain the idea.
(Subject) points out an overlooked risk.
The proposal is detailed and persuasive.
The proposal contains a flaw; (Subject) corrects it when questioned.
The proposal is written on tree bark because (Subject) could not find paper. It works anyway.
The crowd agrees on a sensible compromise.
A loud rival interrupts. The leaders enforce speaking turns.
A child asks an unexpectedly perceptive question.
Several perspectives reveal a better plan.
The group disagrees but records the tradeoffs honestly.
The meeting lasts so long that a parent brings the baby, a blanket, and a snack.
(Subject) is proud but worries about the responsibility.
A former critic says, "I underestimated you." (Subject) replies, "Yes. You did."
(Subject) brings the first official advice to the leaders: "Please make these meetings shorter."
The title changes little. (Subject) still returns home to help with supper.
A child asks whether advisors get crowns. (Subject) says, "Unfortunately, only headaches."

intro.name: The dispute
intro.text: A difficult dispute has stalled the village council: {A}. Several Master villagers have offered conflicting opinions. A quiet villager, (Subject), has been listening.

question.name: A quiet voice
question.text: (Subject) is {a shy apprentice|an overlooked parent|a former laughingstock|an elderly gardener|a quiet researcher|a villager whose earlier advice was ignored}.

choices.label: APPOINT A SMALL, DIVERSE ADVISORY GROUP.

ap1.name: Appointment
ap1.text: The leaders invite (Subject) to serve as a trusted advisor for a trial period.

text_only.reason: rule 7: an appointment is told only

ap2.name: Appointment
ap2.text: The leaders thank (Subject) but decide the proposal needs more evidence.

ap3.name: Appointment
ap3.text: (Subject) declines a formal title but agrees to offer advice when asked.

ap4.name: Appointment
ap4.text: The leaders adopt the proposal and credit (Subject) publicly.
